title: Season shapes fungal enrichment on riverine microplastics relative to co-collected natural particles: analysis code and derived data
description: Analysis code, derived data tables and figures for Season shapes fungal enrichment on riverine microplastics relative to co-collected natural particles. The analysis is a reanalysis of publicly archived shotgun metagenomes; no new sequencing was performed. Sequence data are archived under NCBI BioProjects PRJNA1159715 and PRJNA1330252.
